name: Kinetic Trust Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Kinetic Trust Ltd is in the business of loans & advances, investment, and other financial activity[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
KTL is a Non-Systemically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Finance Company, primarily involved in capital market investments and advisory services. It also offers project consultancy services, including financial structuring and project report preparation.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.48% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Company has high debtors of 343 days.
Working capital days have increased from -736 days to 71.1 days
